notes.title: v0.2.2 - Update Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b] We’ve got a fresh update to make things even better:

[list]
[*] Cards now slide in smoothly, no more hiccups.
[*] Zosia’s secret ending is back and working like a charm.
[*] The R&D Institute used to not load properly—now it’s always visible.
[*] You can hear the flasks clink again in the lab, just like old times.
[*] The music radio remembers if you turned it on or off.
[*] Encrypted stations used to play even after decoding their signal—now they remember if they’ve been listened to.
[/list]

Jump in, have fun, and tell us what you think!
